ios.desc:
Your virtual closet. Your personal stylist. One powerful app.

Style.ai helps you look your best—faster and smarter. Upload a photo of yourself in an outfit and get an instant AI-powered style rating, detailed suggestions, and visual enhancements placed directly onto your image. Whether you’re building a new wardrobe or just trying to improve one outfit, Style.ai gives you real-time fashion guidance tailored to you.

What makes Style.ai different?

We don’t just rate your outfit—we fix it. Our advanced AI analyzes your look and suggests better pieces, accessories, or tweaks—and shows them on your photo, so you can see exactly how your outfit could look upgraded. No guesswork. No styling anxiety.

Key Features:
	•	Instant Outfit Rating – Upload any photo and get a style score with AI-powered feedback
	•	Visual Suggestions – See better outfit combinations or add-ons overlaid on your photo
	•	AI Outfit Generator – Let our stylist recommend full looks tailored to your personal style
	•	Closet Organization (coming soon) – Build your digital wardrobe for smarter styling
	•	Lookbook Mode – Save your best fits and track your evolving style
	•	Inspiration Feed – Browse trending outfits and AI-enhanced looks from others
	•	Shareable Results – Post your rated and upgraded outfits with friends or your audience

Whether you’re going for a capsule wardrobe, prepping for an event, or just want to look more put-together, Style.ai helps you unlock your best style with just one photo.


Style smarter. Visualize better. Dress confidently. With Style.ai.
